shortDescription: Occidental Petroleum NYSE:OXY jumped 4.4% in Thursday's trading as Goldman Sachs upgraded shares to Buy from Neutral with a $69 price target, bumped up from $63, citing the company's differentiated advanced recovery approach, strong outlook for debt reduction and dividend growth potential, targeted…

children: jumped 4.4% in Thursday's trading as Goldman Sachs upgraded shares to Buy from Neutral with a $69 price target, bumped up from $63, citing the company's differentiated advanced recovery approach, strong outlook for debt reduction and dividend growth potential, targeted $4B cash flow improvement by 2030, and an attractive risk/reward skew given the current discounted valuation.
Goldman's Neil Mehta said he has seen strong YTD share price performance from the bank's oil E&P coverage given an elevated oil pricing environment, with Occidental

shares trading in line with the broader coverage despite "structural improvements that OXY has driven across its business through an incremental focus on capital efficiency and deleveraging" under new CEO Richard Jackson.
At the same time, Mehta double-downgraded Tourmaline Oil

to Sell from Buy with a C$49 price target, cut from C$59, citing a challenging Western Canadian natural gas macro environment in the near-term despite long-term progress with LNG Canada Phase 2 FID, a premium valuation relative to peers, and delays to a sustainable free cash flow inflection following the one-year NEBC infrastructure buildout pause.

title: Occidental Petroleum raised to Buy at Goldman on strong debt reduction, dividend growth potential
